understanding.goal_understanding: The goal is to navigate the grid through every level, modify the carried piece so its shape, color, and rotation match each goal cell, then step onto each matched goal to activate and complete it. All goals in a level must be completed to advance, and all levels must be won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs one stamina, while walls block movement and must be avoided using the stated blocked_directions. Shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycle orange to blue to green to red and back to orange, and rotation modifiers rotate clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. A goal activates only when all three piece attributes match its requirements, and stepping onto it completes the goal. When stamina reaches zero, one life is lost and stamina resets; losing all lives ends the game.
